method: native-image-reviewed partial body; marching cubes 0.5; no resampling, smoothing or filling
scope: Partial fornix body including an anterior extension, native Y780-880 (about 10 mm). Superior septal attachment and anterior/posterior cuts remain scope limits, not established anatomical boundaries. Crura, columns, fimbria and continuity to hippocampus/mammillary body remain incomplete. Small internal clefts may remain unresolved at 0.5 mm sampling. Not expert-reviewed.
